reason: A DeepSeek Harness web skin that changes the interface appearance and adds a slider for selecting supported model reasoning effort levels.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供“滑动变祖”主题皮肤，并用滑块选择模型支持的推理档位。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web skin that adds the Liang-themed appearance and a slider for selecting supported model reasoning effort levels.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface appearance
Displays a slider for selecting supported reasoning effort levels
Submits the selected reasoning effort identifier through the official ModelDirectory
Stores the appearance selection in the current browser locally
